title: QA Workspace
subtitle: Analyze requirements, shape cases, automate, run, and recover failures in one project context.

quick.searchPlaceholder: Search requirements, cases, failures, or recorder

journeyFacts.discover: Explore product behavior and compare coverage

flow.failurePendingEvidence: Run needs attention · waiting for failure evidence

noProjectDescription: The Workspace keeps requirement, case, binding, run, and file context together for a project.

dock.title: Run Dock
dock.resultUnavailableHint: Per-case results were not saved; pass/fail counts are unavailable
dock.aiIndependent: AI Run previews a plan to analyze requirements, add cases, generate automation, or run tests. Source writes require approval. Regular Run executes existing automation only.

aiRun.title: AI Run
aiRun.description: AI plans from the selected requirement or case and previews what it will analyze, add, or run. Source writes require approval; execution reuses the platform services.
aiRun.sharedExecutor: After approval, a QA task is created and uses the TestRun executor.

capabilities.plan: Shows steps and risks before starting
capabilities.execute: Runs the actual bound automation case
capabilities.diagnose: Results, failures, and reruns stay in this Workspace

result.providerUsed: This Run has an invocation record
result.providerConfiguredOnly: Configured now; not called by this Run
result.jevEnabledNotCalled: Enabled in settings, but not called by this Run
result.jevNotReached: AI analysis did not complete, so the workflow stopped before the Jev decision.

result.jevActuallyCalled: This Run has a decision record
result.aiInvocationUnlinked: The Task has AI calls that cannot be attributed to this Run

result.jevDecisionUnlinked: The Task has a Jev decision that cannot be attributed to this Run

result.aiNotStarted: AI diagnosis was not started for this Run
result.diffNotGenerated: No code patch diff has been generated
result.patchApprovalPending: The patch is ready and awaits human approval
result.verificationReady: The patch is applied and ready for regression verification

result.repairWorkflowFailed: The failure-repair workflow returned FAILED; this is separate from the original test assertion result.
result.repairWorkflowBlocked: The failure-repair workflow returned BLOCKED; patch application and verification have not started.
result.repairNotApplicable: No locator patch could be safely generated; you can rerun the analysis.
result.repairLoadError: Could not load this Failure's repair workflow. Patch, writeback, and verification states are unknown.
result.failureLoadError: Could not load Failure records linked to this Run. Retry before concluding that no failure workflow exists.
result.aiOutputNotRecorded: The AI call completed, but the backend did not save a diagnosis output summary, so an effective result cannot be confirmed.
result.runtimeLoadError: Could not load Runtime events. The result page will not replace them with simulated states.
result.noScreenshot: This Run has no previewable screenshot artifacts.
result.noCodeLocation: Runtime did not provide a file and line.
result.noArtifacts: This Run has no report or trace artifacts.
result.noRunDescription: Start a run from an automated case and keep its result in this Workspace.
result.runRequiresBinding: Select a case with an active automation binding before starting a run.
result.failureLoading: The run failed. Loading its linked Failure records.
result.resultUnavailable: The runner did not save per-test results
result.resultUnavailableActive: The Run is {{status}}. Per-test TestExecution records have not been saved, so assertion outcomes are unknown.

result.resultUnavailableTerminal: The Run is {{status}}, but has no linked TestExecution, so per-case pass or fail outcomes cannot be confirmed.
